claim: A search that counts newly executed code can miss a place that reuses the same routines; watch a game variable (such as the room number) instead.

evidence.text: The descent into the caverns (up row Q from a hatch gap, room 74 -> 90) was found 2026-11-17 after an earlier search missed it by watching the height and new code, not the room; the room number is at 23479.
evidence.quote: An earlier search missed it by watching the height and new code, not the room.
